The payout shown is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book will pay for a correlated slip. ⚠️ Sam's 1.8x floor is applied to that upper bound, which is sound in one direction only: a slip whose upper bound misses the floor can never reach it. The ceiling is deliberately NOT applied, because an upper bound above it may be inside it once the book discounts.

The payout is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book pays for a correlated slip.

college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in.
